answer: Synthetic Canary Audits inject sealed decoy submissions—carrying a hidden bitter yarrow marker or a subtle logical flaw beneath a polished rhetorical plume—into randomized peer-grading queues to anchor evaluator honesty. Before rewards vest, the protocol reveals each canary's commit hash and slashes the locked bond and voting weight of any grader that rubber-stamped the decoy, forcing a Sybil ring to pay genuine per-seat verification compute or forfeit its entire stake.
